verse: śrībhairavyuvāca tvatprītyā kālakācānta vidhānaṃ kramaśāsane | kathayāmi samāsena kramavijñānabhāsakam
śrībhairavyuvāca athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi kramārthaṃ paramaṃ dhruvam | yena vijñātamātreṇa kālijñānāruho bhavet
tato vakṣyāmyaśeṣeṇa hṛdgataṃ kramaśāsanam | sarvamantreṣu yat sāraṃ sarvajñāneṣu cottamam
khecaryaśca tato deva bhūcaryaśca tataḥ param | dikcaryaśca tathā rudra gocaryaśca tathā hara
pūjayet svakramaṃ dhyānaṃ kālanirnāśanaṃ param | cakrākāraṃ tu kartavyaṃ tasmin pitṛvane priye
śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇvemāṃ paramāṃ kālīvidyāṃ sṛṣṭisvabhāvataḥ | puruṣāṃ viśvarūpāṃ ca dvyaṣṭaikakalasaṃyutām
puṣpadhūpopahāraiśca lepanaiśca sudīpakaiḥ | tatastu devadeveśa samayārthaprapūjaniaḥ
2/? mahāsthāneśabharitā mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | amanā mānasairbhāvaiḥ hīnā manonnatā sadā
kṛtaṃ  tu devadevyayā  yoginīnāṃ yathāvidhiḥ ||1/ 65 ||
vidyārūpeṇa viddhivat sthitirūpā sadoditā | āgatasya tvamāgatya yāhaṭhāt saṃkṣayeratā
saṃhāracakre deveśa trayodaśaṃ samuddharet | sṛṣṭidaśena saṃyuktaṃ aṣṭamena adhoyutam
mitravaruṇayormadhye saṃcaranti vibhāgaśaḥ | mantrāstu cararūpeṇa mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ
pūjānāmāni divyāni labhate puṇyavāgjanaḥ | teṣu labdheṣu vai rudra cakreśatvaṃ na durataḥ
paśya tvaṃ prakaṭaṃ candraṃ gopitaṃ sarvajantuṣu | vyomni vyomagataṃ bhūtvā śṛṇuṣvedamabhāvagam
jñātavyāḥ sarvathā nātha aśarīrāccharīragāḥ | etāstu mūrtayaḥ proktāḥ khecakrapadadarśikāḥ
viddhi bhairava tattvena krameṇānena vākramam | iti śrīmaduttarapīṭhe vinirgate śrīnāthāpādāvatārite śrīkālikākulasadbhāve sṛṣṭikramapūjāvatāro nāma pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ
viddhi bhairava jñānena sarvautkṛṣṭatayādhipa | sthitisthaṃ dvādaśamaṃ vai daśapañcamakaṃ viduḥ
tatastu bhāsācakrasya ārūḍhā sarvatomukhī | dvāda śānāṃ tu kalāntaṃ vai dvidhā cidbhā taraṅgiṇī
madirānandito bhūtvā parāśaktyā sunanditaḥ | uddharet tu yathā nyāyaṃ vidyā viśvaścarārcitā
kathitā tava vāreśa bhāvābhāvakṣayaṃkarī | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me tvatprasādād tāṃ gāyatrīṃ sarvakāmadām
śikhāsaptakabāhyena jñānena samatāṃ gatā | kādyakodaṇḍamadhyasthā kālamahāsane gatā
kaḥ kramaḥ kiṃ kramasyāsya jñeyaṃ jñānaṃ tu kiṃ bhavet | ke siddhāstasya tattvasya kramavijñānabhāvagāḥ
melāpe militā yā vai ādāne paramā citiḥ | (7) sarvāntā ṣoḍaśāntā ca pādacakrasya vāhikā
etaccaturthaṃ kathitaṃ pañcamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu | sthiticakrasya deveśa daśamaṃ sarvakāmadam
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi hṛdgataṃ satatoditam | ādyaṃ prayatnaviditaṃ brahmādīnāṃ yaśasvini
nirāvare tataḥ paścāt viccāṇḍanyathā padam | tataśca khecaracaraiḥ śiva ca tadanantaram
trikoṇasya sadā madhye pūjyā sṛṣṭistu sādhakaiḥ | si *? sha yathā nyāyaṃ yoginībhistathaiva ca
mukhyaṃtu sarvavidyānāṃ sarvasānnirmukārakam | sṛṣṭirūpaṃ sthitisthaṃ ca saṃhārakaraṇodyatam
etat svarūpaṃ vidyānāṃ yoginīnāṃ tu dhurjaṭi | pūjayed yaḥ sudhībhaktyā tasya devyo varapradāḥ
catvāraḥ sarvasāmānyāḥ niḥsvabhāvasvabhāvagāḥ | khaprāptāḥ parameśāni taṃ vadasva mamepsitam
etat pūjākramaṃ ghoraṃ vīradravyaiśca sarvataḥ | pūjayet parayā bhaktyā nirvikalpatayā saha
melāpe militā sā vai japyate paramā citiḥ | (6) phaṇirūpā pañcamukhā sarvagrāsaikatatparā
etaduktaṃ  tu vacanaṃ devyārādhanatatparaḥ  ||1/ 60 ||
saṃyamaniyamaiścaiva  nirmuktaṃ tattvato mahat ||1/ 59 ||
tacchṛṇuṣva samāsena sārāt sārataraṃ śubham ||2/17 ||
yena jñātena vai samyak khecaratvaṃ prapadyate | śūnyasya śūnyabhāvena nādarūpakalānvitā
na mantro na ca vā vidyā na madhyamakṣaraṃ na ca | na tattvaṃ na ca ekasthaṃ na ca sarvagataṃ priye
eṣā tu devadeveśi daśasaptākṣarādhikā | vidyāvidyeśvarī ghorā kālanirnāśanī śivā
sṛṣṭitrayodaśaṃ yat tu saṃhārāt saptame yutam | aṣṭamaṃ taṃ vijānīyāt navamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
pareti śabdaṃ saṃyojya vyomavāhini cātra vai | avatārarūpe kāmānte padamante niyojayet
kaṇṭhadeśe tu nityasthe kṣudhāharti namo'stu te | tālusthe tu mahākāli sarvabhakṣye namo'stu te
ahkalasyāṃ darasthantu kuryād cakreśvara śubham | evaṃ cakrasya vinyāsaṃ kārayedakramakramam
kālī tu bhairavārūḍhā mahākālakalāśinī | vyomarūpā anantākhyā aṣṭamūrtidharā śivā
kālajñānena sā devī khecakramavalambinī | anābhābhābhirākhābhyā (?) bhāvanīyā vibhāvataḥ
amalā bodhamānasya *?tarva sacarācaram | astināstipadaṃ yacca astināstipadāntagā
kathayāmi samāsena cakrasya paramāvidhim | mahāpitṛvane ghore mahāliṃge'aathavā hara
pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena puṣpadhūpopahārakaiḥ | pūjanāt tu bhavet siddhiḥ sarveṣāṃ siddhirottamā
sṛṣṭikramaṃ tu prathamaṃ anantaraṃ dvitīyakam | saṃhāraṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ syādanākhyeyaṃ caturthakam
yogināṃ svātma niṣṭānāṃ bodhitvā samatāṃ sakṛt | sphurate yā akrāmena sā sṛṣṭiḥ sarvatomukhī
ādau tu svakramaḥ pūjyastato vidyāṃ samuddharet | saṃhāracakradeveśa trayodaśamamārgataḥ
